name: The X Protocol
overview: Set in 1990, two bright ninth-grade students, Louiser and White, begin to uncover a terrifying secret hidden within their school. As strange and supernatural events surrounding their principal, Dravin, grow increasingly disturbing, the friends find themselves trapped in a haunting mystery that threatens their lives and everyone around them. A chilling prequel to the horror story Terror of X.
